title: AnimatedCrossFade outer size adopts a child size change one frame late
evidence: Revised. The earlier claim (outgoing child keeps 90 px width) no longer reproduces: at HEAD the child is 150 px at frame 3 in both. The divergence is that Incular's outer box still measures 90 px at frame 3 (child overflows right, x=355), while Flutter's has begun to grow (x=325). Frame 4 onward matches. On reversal at frame 11 (176 ms) Incular keeps the previous 150 px outer box for one frame with the child left-aligned (x=325), Flutter snaps to the 90 px child (x=355). Same mechanism as switchers-002 (AnimatedSize adopts child size one frame late).
impact: During a cross-fade between children of different widths, the child is offset by up to 30 px for one frame at each state change.
cause: AnimatedCrossFade wraps its stack in AnimatedSize (animated_cross_fade.rs:228-230); the one-frame adoption lag in AnimatedSize.child_laid_out (animated_size.rs:128-175) shows up here.
fix_direction: Fix switchers-002; re-check this scenario afterwards.
limitations: Frame recorder reads outer rect only through the child probe; paint order and clipping are not compared.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md

title: AnimatedSize retarget uses the previous animation tick
evidence: Frame 10 matches (117.33x62.4 on both). At frame 11 Flutter stays at 117.33x62.4 while Incular advances to 122.67x65.6 before reversing toward the new target. Max size difference 5.33 px. Re-run at HEAD gives the same numbers.
impact: A mid-flight target change moves the box one extra frame toward the old target, a visible jump.
cause: Incular applies the child's new size after the frame's tick has already sized the box; Flutter updates its target before computing that frame's size.
fix_direction: Apply target-size changes in the same layout pass that computes the outer size, starting from the last displayed size.

title: AnimatedSwitcher transition builder receives a scalar
evidence: The default transition trace matches. The type alias at animated_switcher.rs:16 is Fn(Widget, f32) -> Widget; Flutter's callback receives Animation<double>.
impact: Custom builders cannot inspect status, pass the animation on, or listen to it.
cause: Incular reduces the callback input to the sampled fraction.
fix_direction: Pass a cloneable animation handle with value and status to the callback.

title: AnimatedSize reverseDuration API surface differs
evidence: Flutter accepts reverseDuration, but its size state machine only calls forward (no reverse() in rendering/animated_size.dart). Incular's AnimatedSize has no reverse-duration setter (rg finds no reverse in animated_size.rs).
impact: No reachable timing difference found; source-level configuration gap only.
fix_direction: No behavior change indicated; add the property only if source compatibility is required.

title: AnimatedModalBarrier cannot animate to null color
evidence: The non-null color twin and dismissal match over 27 frames. barrier.rs:18 is Animation<Color>; Flutter accepts Animation<Color?>.
impact: A no-fill endpoint cannot be expressed while keeping barrier interaction.
cause: The barrier color animation is non-nullable.
fix_direction: Support an optional sampled color; keep hit testing and semantics when None.

title: SliverAnimatedList builder omits its item animation
evidence: Initial layout matches. SliverAnimatedList::new (sliver_lists.rs:966) takes impl Fn(usize) -> W; Flutter's AnimatedItemBuilder receives Animation<double>.
impact: User item builders cannot add per-item fade or slide during insertion and removal in SliverAnimatedList.
cause: The extent animation is internal and not passed to the builder.
fix_direction: Expose the retained item animation to the builder, as AnimatedList::animated does.
limitations: Insertion and removal not frame-tested (see Harness requests).

title: AnimatedList keeps a removed item one frame after its exit animation completes
evidence: Outgoing item size, the removed builder output and the index shift of remaining items match on all frames through 20. At frame 21 (336 ms) Flutter has removed the outgoing item; Incular still shows it with size 0.00 and removes it on the next frame.
impact: Visually none (zero height). The removed item's state and any zero-size semantics or focus node persist one extra frame.
cause: Incular removes the retained slot on the tick after completion; Flutter removes it in the completing frame.
fix_direction: Remove the outgoing slot in the same tick that observes completion.
limitations: Presence is measured by the probe; disposal timing not observed directly.
verified_by: orchestrator package rerun (scenario-backed) or independent source verification (source-only); see VERIFICATION.md and verification-source-findings.md
